verse.text: The Lord directs the steps of the godly. He delights in every detail of their lives. Though they stumble, they will never fall, for the Lord holds them by the hand.

video.title: The Steps of a Good Man | Psalm 37:23

reflection: A godly dad doesn't have to have every step figured out — he just has to keep walking with the Lord, trusting that God is directing the path even through the stumbles. When you mess up in front of your kids (and you will), let them see you get back up, because that's the real lesson: not perfection, but a steady hand held by the Father who never lets go.
